newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran has no expansionist ambitions - commander.
newsitem.headline: Iran has no expansionist ambitions - commander.

text.p: Iran has no expansionist ambitions but could counter any aggression against its territory, a senior Iranian military officer said in remarks published on Saturday.

Brigadier Rahim Ebrahimi, deputy commander of ground forces for intelligence and operations, told the English-language Tehran Times the Islamic republic's forces, with their experience in the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war, could crack down on any aggression against Iranian territory.
They were ready to enter the scene, whenever and wherever there was possible aggression against Iran, upon the permission of Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
Commenting on the U.S. military presence in the Gulf and its action against Iraq, Ebrahimi said Washington was pursuing nothing but its own interests.
